description: Inspect the security and privacy state of a Word .docx: whether it is password-encrypted and with which algorithm, editing restriction mode and whether it is password-protected, presence of a text watermark, and privacy metadata (author, last modified by, company, manager, timestamps, custom properties, comment/revision author names). For encrypted files, pass the password to also inspect the contents. Max input 20MB base64. Privacy: when called remotely (Streamable HTTP / SSE) the file is uploaded to the DocMorph server and processed in memory only; it is not written to disk or retained after processing, and passwords and file contents are never logged. When the MCP server runs locally over stdio, the file is processed entirely on this machine.

base64Docx.description: Base64 encoded .docx binary data (or data URI), encrypted or not

password.description: Optional open password of an encrypted .docx, to also inspect its contents

name: word_inspect_security
